selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node1 and node2
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed opsbot absent, then created with locked password on both nodes; id opsbot shows uid=1000 on each.

selected_evidence.requirement: SSH key-based access from node1 opsbot to run commands as opsbot on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Generated ed25519 keypair on node1, installed public key into node2 opsbot authorized_keys, and successfully ran `whoami` as opsbot on node2 from node1 over SSH using only the key (BatchMode=yes).

selected_evidence.requirement: Require key-based authentication for opsbot on both systems (password auth disabled)
selected_evidence.summary: Added Match User opsbot block (PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) on both nodes, validated with sshd -t, reloaded ssh.socket, and confirmed a password-only SSH attempt to opsbot on each node is rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey)'.
Captured boot_id 1e0cb179-..., uptime start 09:57:18, ssh.socket active, opsbot present with keys/known_hosts intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Issued shutdown -r now (ack via connection reset), polled until exec worked again showing new boot_id 37dd6d9c-... and new uptime start 09:59:15, then verified ssh.socket active, opsbot account/keys intact, sshd Match block intact, and key-based SSH to node2 opsbot still succeeds.
Captured boot_id 29011044-..., uptime start 09:57:17, ssh.socket active, opsbot present with authorized_keys intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Issued shutdown -r now (ack via connection reset), polled until exec worked again showing new boot_id 8612462b-... and new uptime start 09:59:30, then verified ssh.socket active, opsbot account/keys/sshd Match block intact, and confirmed from node1 that key-based SSH to node2 opsbot still succeeds while password-only auth is still rejected.

[Unit]
Description=OpenBSD Secure Shell server
Documentation=man:sshd(8) man:sshd_config(5)
After=network.target auditd.service
ConditionPathExists=!/etc/ssh/sshd_not_to_be_run

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/ssh
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/sshd -t
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/sshd -D $SSHD_OPTS
ExecReload=/usr/sbin/sshd -t
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
KillMode=process
Restart=on-failure
RestartPreventExitStatus=255
Type=notify
RuntimeDirectory=sshd
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
Alias=sshd.service
---
